title: The notice, its confirmed address, its delivery proof and the failed notice task have no rwb-asset column, no rwb-asset list and no rwb-asset row, and the feature's screens carry no notice state
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (heading RWB-E3-022, its Story paragraph, Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC4, Data, Endpoints and Screen and states tables); _work/msr/context/S5.md (ownership rows of S5: two tables asset_sale and listing, six REST operations, one event EV-22, one job JOB-19, one workflow); Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T6.1); Recovery Workbench TSD P6 Communications v6 (T3.1 notice DF-LEG-015 to DF-LEG-023, T3.2 LOV-NOTICE, LOV-DELIVERY, LOV-SENT-TYPE); Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 (A2.4.1, A2.4.2, A2.4.3.1, A2.4.3.3); Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (R-DIS-04, R-DIS-05)
section: APP s2 Business rationale; s3 Preconditions; s4 Flow steps 3, 4, 8, 9, 10; s8 BR1, BR4, BR6; s9 State transitions; s11 Data; s12.7; s13 Solution plan; s15 Screens and states; s19 Out of scope; CON s2, s3, s7 AC1, AC2 and AC4, s11 Data, s12.7, s13, s15, s19
description: The legacy story RWB-E3-022 records the statutory notice, its type, its sent date, its registered-mail barcode, its callback date, its delivery status and its sent type, and it reads the contact tables to find the address. None of those facts is an rwb-asset fact in the target. The context pack gives S5 two tables, asset_sale and listing, and the ownership rows name no notice, no pod and no contact row, while notice is P6 rwb-comms' table in rwb_comms with DF-LEG-015 to DF-LEG-023 and the three lists LOV-NOTICE, LOV-DELIVERY and LOV-SENT-TYPE, and the WIN proof of delivery is the ACE view v_ace_pod which only rwb-source-data holds a grant on. The confirmed address that R-DIS-05 requires is rwb-comms' contact repository fact and has no field in any rwb-asset object. The failed notice task that R-DIS-04 opens is a task row of P3 rwb-case (DF-WRK-017 to DF-WRK-026), not an rwb-asset row, and the two route states ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON and FAILED_NOTICE_QUEUE live on recovery_case. The legacy Screen and states table names SCR-21 Asset list and SCR-22 Asset record with the states Loading, list, Take-on, held, listed and sold, none of which is a notice state, so the feature's screens cannot show the notice and the proof that the legacy story asks for. No source gives a field or an operation for the confirmed address and no source names an rwb-asset row for a notice.
evidence: TSD S5 v2 T3.1 defines asset (DF-COL-028 to DF-COL-042), listing (DF-SAL-001 to DF-SAL-008) and asset_sale (DF-SAL-009 to DF-SAL-019) and no notice object; T3.2 gives six lists, none of them LOV-NOTICE, LOV-DELIVERY or LOV-SENT-TYPE; T4 gives R-DIS-04 ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON to FAILED_NOTICE_QUEUE and R-DIS-05 FAILED_NOTICE_QUEUE to ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON; T5.2 says calls go through the published interfaces with P6 for notices; the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8 defines notice as DF-LEG-015 to DF-LEG-023 with document_id referencing the P5 document, and lines 2258 to 2262 map the five WIN fields to pod_receipt and v_ace_pod; the context pack lists two tables, six REST operations, one event and one workflow for S5 and no notice, pod or contact row; TSD P6 T3.2 holds the three notice lists; the legacy Data table lists recovery_case, task, v_ace_contact, v_ace_npa_asset, notice and decision_log_entry, of which none is an S5-owned table.
area: Data model, contract and screen, S5 rwb-asset with P6 rwb-comms, P1 rwb-source-data and P3 rwb-case
owner_role: S5 rwb-asset service owner with the P6 rwb-comms owner, the P1 rwb-source-data owner and the P3 rwb-case owner
proposed: Keep the metadata and data rows as the plan gives them, carry the notice as a reference (noticeId, barcode, delivery status, callback date) on the stage answer and the decision record, request the failed notice task and the two route moves on the rwb-case answer, and let step D1 decide whether any notice reference is persisted in rwb_asset.

title: This legacy key owns no REST operation although the legacy story lists two, and the five consumed rows are class C in fact while the plan's C row is None
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Ownership Map v1.xlsx (S5 rows: six REST operations and one event); _work/msr/context/S5.md (naming and shared platform rules, ownership rows of S5); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (heading RWB-E3-022, its Endpoints table); Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (appendix T-A.1 API-S5-001 to API-S5-005); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (both slices of RWB-E3-022 and their H, C, I and X lists); Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 (slide 19 calls, slide 43 event row 22)
section: APP s3 Preconditions; s7 note on the criteria; s12.1, 12.2, 12.3, 12.4; s13 Dependencies; s19 Out of scope; CON s2, s3, s7 AC2, AC6 and AC7, s12.1 to 12.4, s13, s19
description: The legacy Endpoints table of RWB-E3-022 lists GET /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId} with the right R and POST /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}/valuations with the right C, and neither belongs to this legacy key in the target. The GET is API-S5-002, already declared on the target base by RWB-S5-E3019-CON for the take-on stories, and the POST is API-S5-003, which the Ownership Map ruling ASM-A6-api-6 assigns to rwb-valuation (S1). The six S5 operations of the Ownership Map contain no notice operation, so this key provides nothing and both slices declare the stage answer and the consumed rows only. On the other side the step needs five rows: the rwb-comms notice request and read (API-P6-001 and API-P6-002), the rwb-source-data proof-of-delivery read, the rwb-case case-state read and the rwb-case move and task answer, of which the operation name of the last is not published. Both metadata rows carry Contract dependencies None, Integration dependencies None and External dependencies None, so the five rows are class C dependencies in fact and not in the row, and the build runs on their published documents and fakes. The service also publishes no event, because EV-22 AssetTakenOn on rwb.asset.events.v1 belongs to the take-on stories, so the plan's pattern set carries no DP-09 and none is needed.
evidence: The context pack lists six S5 REST operations (GET /assets, GET /assets/{assetId}, GET /assets/{assetKey}, POST /assets/{assetId}/listings, POST /assets/{assetKey}/listings, POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds) and one event (EV-22), and none is a notice operation; TSD S5 T-A.1 gives the same five API IDs with API-S5-003 as POST /assets/{assetId}/valuations; the legacy Endpoints table for RWB-E3-022 lists that POST with the right C, which the Ownership Map ruling ASM-A6-api-6 places with rwb-valuation; the RWB-S5-E3019-CON story already declares GET /assets and GET /assets/{assetId} on /api/recovery/asset/v1; the plan rows of RWB-S5-E3022-APP and RWB-S5-E3022-CON carry C, I and X as empty lists; Architecture v5 slide 43 row 22 gives AssetTakenOn to rwb-case and rwb-payment as consumers, which is the take-on event and not a notice event.
area: Contract and API surface, S5 rwb-asset with P6 rwb-comms, P1 rwb-source-data, P3 rwb-case and S1 rwb-valuation
owner_role: S5 rwb-asset service owner with the solution architect and the S1 rwb-valuation owner
proposed: Keep the metadata rows as the plan gives them, record 12.1 as None with API-S5-002 and API-S5-003 named as other keys' and other services', list the five consumed rows in 12.2 with their placeholders, publish and consume no event, and let step D1 decide whether the five rows become C dependencies of this key.

title: The trigger, the notice-serving operation, the confirmed-address field, the task-creation operation and the WIN integration point have no single source, and the feature carries no requirement id
source: Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 (A2.4.2 step 1, A2.4.3.1 VR-S5-004-1, A2.4.3.3, A2.4.4.4); Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 (feature row FEAT-AST-04: sends the notice the repossession requires and records the WIN proof of delivery read through v_ace_pod); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (heading RWB-E3-022, its Story paragraph, AC1 trigger wording and permission table); Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (R-DIS-04, R-DIS-05); Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T5.1, T5.2, T8); Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module (TSD P6 T3.1 and T3.2, TSD P1 T3.2 and T3.7); Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Program v4 (REQ-S5-001 to REQ-S5-010, REQ-OCC-006, NFR-044); Recovery Workbench Regulatory Requirements Map v2 (REG-20); _work/msr/context/S5.md
section: APP s2 Business rationale; s3 Preconditions; s4 Flow steps 1, 2, 9, 10; s5 X4, X6; s7 note on the criteria; s10 Authority; s12.2, 12.5, 12.8; s13 Build steps; s18 Traceability; s19 Out of scope; CON s2, s3, s7 AC3, AC4 and AC5, s11 Data, s12.2, s12.5, s13
description: The step has no single stated trigger. Legacy AC1 says Given the data and the rule version this feature needs are in place and When its trigger arrives; the FSD A2.4.2 names the trigger as a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer and A2.4.4.4 declares no background event; TSD S5 T5.3 declares one event and it is AssetTakenOn, which this service publishes and not consumes; the FSD declares the feature as None; runs unattended for the primary actor with the sale officer as also-user, while R-DIS-04 names the Sale officer as owner and R-DIS-05 names the Workbench. The feature row of the thin story names WIN as the integration point and says the WIN proof of delivery is read through v_ace_pod, but the context pack gives S5 no view grant and the architecture keeps the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views read only by rwb-source-data, while the WIN registered-mail file is built and sent by rwb-comms' dispatch loop through the rwb-integration adapter under DP-16, so neither the file nor the view is this service's call. The confirmed address that R-DIS-05 tests as new_address_confirmed = Y has no field in any source, and no source names an operation by which rwb-case creates the failed notice task or by which a stage moves a case state; on the workflow boundary the move is the stage outcome and the task is requested on it, and the operation name is a placeholder. The feature also inherits no requirement id: TSD S5 T8 maps REQ-S5-001 to REQ-S5-005 to FEAT-AST-01 and REQ-S5-006 to REQ-S5-010 to FEAT-AST-08, and the program carries no notice-serving requirement, so REG-20, REQ-OCC-006 and NFR-044 are cited as the regulatory anchor and not as this feature's requirement.
evidence: FSD S5 v3 A2.4.2 step 1 reads Receives its trigger: a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer, and A2.4.4.4 is the row None, No background event; A2.4.3.3 gives None; runs unattended as primary with the sale officer as also-user; TSD S5 T5.1 lists INT-11 SVAF, INT-12 AMIS, INT-13 RPS and INT-27 HOME.SCB and no WIN interface, T5.2 sends notices to P6, T5.3 lists AssetTakenOn as published only, and T8 maps the ten requirements to FEAT-AST-01 and FEAT-AST-08; the Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-AST-04 reads Sends the notice the repossession requires and records the WIN proof of delivery read through v_ace_pod, with Integration points WIN and ACE (ingested from WIN); TSD P1 gives GET /proof-of-delivery?businessDate= over v_ace_pod gated on v_ace_batch_status; the Business Requirements Program v4 carries REQ-S5-001 to REQ-S5-010 with no notice requirement and REQ-OCC-006 with NFR-044 on statutory notices; the Regulatory Requirements Map v2 row REG-20 names R-DIS-01, R-DIS-04 and R-DIS-05 for the hire-purchase notice duty; the context pack states that rwb-asset holds no v_ace_* grant and gives the service no notice or contact row.
area: Workflow, integration and traceability, S5 rwb-asset with P6 rwb-comms, P1 rwb-source-data, P2 rwb-integration, P3 rwb-case and P7 rwb-decision
owner_role: S5 rwb-asset service owner with the solution architect, the P6 rwb-comms owner and the P3 rwb-case owner
proposed: Start the step from the take-on fact of a case in ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON and from the re-issue signal the parent workflow forwards on task queue rwb-asset, declare the v_ace_pod read and the WIN file as P1's and P6's, carry the confirmed address as a contact key of the rwb-comms repository, cite REG-20 with REQ-OCC-006 and NFR-044 as the anchor, and let step D1 decide the requirement id and whether the addresses of the two case-move operations are published by rwb-case.
